A '''bosun''' served on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. He notified [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] that a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] carrying [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], escaped the [[Skirmish at Krake Data Vault|skirmish at the Krake Data Vault]].
